開いてますよ、{10}さん。{0c:fe}

{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
It's open, {10}-san.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: It's open, [HERO]-san.
That was quick. You've taken that fort already?

strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
It has been a long time, Orpheus-san.{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: It has been a long time, Orpheus-san.

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
Oh... Sadiya-san... is that you?{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Oh... Sadiya-san... is that you?

strings.read:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 毒術師サディーヤ 】{0b:09}
ええ。{1a}入ってもよろしいですか?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
Yes.{1a}May I come in?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Yes. // May I come in?

strings.read:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 オルフェウス 】{0b:09}
ええ、もちろん。{0c:fe}
strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
By all means.{0c:fe}
strings.tl: By all means.
Four years, is it... Yet you haven't changed at all. As lovely as ever.

strings.read:
{0c:5121}{1c:13}{0b:08}【 毒術師サディーヤ 】{0b:09}
あなたも変わりませんね。{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{0c:5121}{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
You have not changed either.{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: You have not changed either.
Oh, but I have. This beautiful skin of mine, once called the pearl of the southern seas... look at it now.

strings.read:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 毒術師サディーヤ 】{0b:09}
その軽口がですよ。{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
It is that glib tongue I mean.{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: It is that glib tongue I mean.
Without it, I wouldn't be me. // Besides, this temperament suits me best. // So, what brings you here? Could it be, you have come for my love...

strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
No. {10}-san invited me...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: No. [HERO]-san invited me...
That dim-witted ugly oaf? Your taste has gone downhill, Sadiya-san.
That is not it. It is.[1].[2].[3]Orpheus-san, your.[4].[5].
I know. No doubt that ugly oaf called you here out of concern for my health. // Honestly, what a meddling fellow, for an ugly oaf.
I have prepared several medicines. They can do little more than ease the pain, but...

strings.jp:
{1c:11}{0b:08}{e080} {03}オルフェウス {e081}{0b:09}
{02}ありがとうございます。
でも別にいいですよ、
死ぬ覚悟は出来てますから。{1a}それに、{01}4{02}・{01}5{e088}{02}で死ぬと
言われていながら
結{e096}もう{01}8{e088}{02}にもなるんです。{1a}むしろ感謝しなきゃ。{1a}ま、この悪運もそろそろ尽きようと
しているようですが。{0c:2b5309fe}

{1c:11}{0b:08}【 {03}オルフェウス 】{0b:09}

結局もう{01}8年{02}にもなるんです。{1a}むしろ感謝しなきゃ。{1a}ま、この悪運もそろそろ尽きようと

strings.tl: Thank you. But there is really no need. I am quite ready to die. // Besides, they told me I would be dead in four or five years, and here it has been eight. // If anything, I ought to be grateful. // Though this wicked luck of mine does seem about to run out at last.

strings.read:
{1c:12}{0b:08}【 毒術師サディーヤ 】{0b:09}
オルフェウスさん・・・{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{1c:12}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
Orpheus-san...{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: Orpheus-san...
Still, I am content with this life. I am truly glad I met you all. [HERO]-san above all... // Of course, I wouldn't say so to his face if it killed me. It's such a bother when he gets above himself.
You truly have not changed, Orpheus-san. // No, it is Irenius-san now, is it not?
Orpheus will do. // 'Father of the Irenians'... Such an embarrassing name. Who on earth came up with it...
Qumran-san and Fatum-san were surprised as well. // That you, of all people, Orpheus-san, are now a nation's head of state.

strings.jp:
{1c:10}{0b:08}{e080} オルフェウス {e081}{0b:09}
ええ、自分でも驚いています。
いつの間にこんなことに
なっちゃったのかって。{1a}初めは不愉快な貴{e0a0}達を
ストレス発散のために
イジめてただけなんですけどね。{1a}それがいつの間にか
{e0a1}衆の英雄になっちゃって。
あれよあれよという間に
1つの勢力になってしまった・・・{1a}まぁ、ぼくの美しさが
{e0a1}衆の、{e09a}に女性達のハートを
有無を言わさず掴んで
しまったことは否定しませんが、{1a}今の身分はいささか窮屈ですね。
ま、もうじき
{e0a8}{e08f}の人に戻りますけど。{0c:2b5309fe}

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
Yes, it surprises me too. How did it all
come to this, I wonder.{1a}At first I was only tormenting
unpleasant nobles to let off steam,
you see.{1a}Then before I knew it, I had become a
hero of the people. In the blink of an eye
it had grown into a faction of its own...{1a}Well, I won't deny that my beauty seized
the hearts of the people, women
especially, without giving them any say in
the matter,{1a}but my present station is rather stifling.
Ah well, I shall soon be an ordinary
man again.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Yes, it surprises me too. How did it all come to this, I wonder. // At first I was only tormenting unpleasant nobles to let off steam, you see. // Then before I knew it, I had become a hero of the people. In the blink of an eye it had grown into a faction of its own... // Well, I won't deny that my beauty seized the hearts of the people, women especially, without giving them any say in the matter, // but my present station is rather stifling. Ah well, I shall soon be an ordinary man again.

strings.read:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 毒術師サディーヤ 】{0b:09}
元首の座を降りるのですか?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.en:
{1c:13}{0b:08}【 Sadiya the Poisoner 】{0b:09}
You will step down as head of state?{0c:2b5109fe}
strings.tl: You will step down as head of state?

strings.jp:
{1c:10}{0b:08}{e080} オルフェウス {e081}{0b:09}
ええ。
もう支え無しでは立つことすら
出来ませんから。{1a}それに、死んだ後に
後継者争いが{e0ae}こるのも
避けた方がいいですし。{1a}{e09a}に、あのブ男を担ぎ出す人間が
出てくると厄{e092}ですからね。{1a}あの男は、顔が少{e0b1}不細{e0b2}なだけで
人間としては申し分ないんですが、{1a}やはりイレニア人の上に立つには
生粋のイレニア人でないと。
しかも、彼はよりにもよって
バイレステの貴{e0a0}の出ですから。{1a}{e09c}王相手の{e0b4}{e0b1}の大活躍のおかげで、
今は彼も{e0a1}衆の英雄ですが、
平{e095}になったときに彼が頭だと
必ず不満が出る・・・{1a}後ろから刺されてお終いでは
彼も{e0b8}哀想ですし。{1a}だからこそ、ぼくが生きている間に
次の元{e09d}を選んでおかないと。{0c:020801}

strings.en:
{1c:10}{0b:08}【 Orpheus 】{0b:09}
Yes. I can no longer even stand
without support.{1a}Besides, it would be best to avoid a war
of succession after my death.{1a}It would be especially troublesome if
someone were to put that ugly
oaf forward.{1a}The man is a little homely, but as a
human being he leaves nothing to
be desired.{1a}Still, to stand above the Irenians one
must be an Irenian born and bred. And he,
of all things, comes from the
Bailestean nobility.{1a}Thanks to his many great exploits
against the king, he too is a hero of the
people now, but with him at the head
once peace comes, there would surely{1a}be discontent...{1a}It would be a pity for him if it all ended
with a knife in the back.{1a}That is why I must choose the next head
of state while I am still alive.{0c:020801}

Yes, quite so.{0c:2b5309fe}
strings.tl: Yes, quite so.

Losing her husband right after the wedding would only be crueler for her, surely. // Besides, Irenian custom differs somewhat from other lands, and a widow meets with all sorts of inconvenience.
That is a man's logic. I believe she is waiting for you to declare yourself.
Besides, I have been busy all this while. I still am, in fact.
That, too, is a man's logic. Excuses are unbecoming.
Above all, I hate weddings. // I enjoy poking fun at people, but being the one poked fun at, well... // And in this position, I could hardly get away with doing nothing.
You truly have not changed, Orpheus-san. // No, it is Irenius-san now, is it not?
Orpheus will do. // 'Father of the Irenians'... Such an embarrassing name. Who on earth came up with it...
Qumran-san and Fatum-san were surprised as well. // That you, of all people, Orpheus-san, are now a nation's head of state.

without support.{1a}Besides, a war of succession after my

too much...{1a}That is why I must choose the next head
of state while I am still alive.{0c:020401}
